Quantum fields in empty space determine the rules of the physical universe.
What looks empty is not empty. What looks dark is not dead. What looks silent may still be filled with hidden activity.
The darkness between the stars is not nothing. It is filled with fields. It is filled with potential. It is the ground state of reality.
We carry places in the mind, heart, body, and soul that look empty... but maybe those places are not empty either. Maybe they are waiting for a holy convocation.
A holy convocation is a sacred assembly, a summoned gathering, a pause from ordinary life to come before God.
You are not separate from the field. You are a living arrangement of it. A pattern. A configuration. A temporary, beautiful, self-organizing expression of created reality.
The soul is where that pattern becomes personal. The soul is where meaning enters the system.
We can look at the darkness in front of us and decide whether we will fill it with fear or fill it with light.
If fear sits at the center, our choices reflect fear. But if God sits at the center, and love is allowed to lead, then our choices begin to reflect light.
A holy convocation is a sacred reset. It is God saying, 'Stop. Come back. Remember who you are. Remember who made you.'
The darkness between stars is not empty. The darkness inside you is not hopeless. It can become the canvas. And love is the paintbrush.
You are not just matter. You are meaning moving through matter.
Try love. Not because it is easy, but because it creates.
Your nervous system reacts. Your soul can choose.
